unsupported_additions: “十多丈高” specifies height, whereas the original only states an extent of more than ten zhang.
“灵帝” makes the emperor’s identity explicit; this is contextually supported but not stated in the excerpt.
distortions: “从房梁上飞下来” omits the original’s vivid “只见” presentation, but this is stylistic and immaterial.
“黑气十多丈高” slightly narrows the original “黑气十余丈,” which does not specifically indicate height.
